text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the Tenno Sho (Spring) arrived.
Oguri Cap
clashed with Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I lost, huh!
Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama...
Did I... defeat you...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Spacing out again, are ya!
Yeah, you won!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —This time, at least.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The next one to win will be me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! I lost...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Tama is strong, just as I thought...
So very strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as Oguri Cap looks frustrated,
she also seems genuinely thrilled deep down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is likely thrilled that her best friend is this strong,
and that she gets to be rivals with her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't chase her back next time.
I'll run ahead of Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ha, look at you talkin'!
Ya think I'd let ya pass me that easily?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Next time, it's mine too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The battle to decide who's the strongest has only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Let's meet again at the Autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Nailed it!
See ya—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wait!
Tama, you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're not coming back to the dorms until autumn?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: YOU TOTAL IDIOOOOT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
I must run in the autumn Tenno Sho."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll settle things with Tama there.
Would that be alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before the Arima Kinen.
Oguri Cap's next goal was decided!
